tools.name: perform_secondary_action

tools.description: Run a bounded sequence of desktop actions while carrying current window, screenshotId, and accessibilityRevision. Use target.app_filter/window_title_filter to resolve a window, post_step_sleep_ms for short waits, final_state:true to verify once, and element_text or element_index for semantic UIA actions.

auto_text_state_for_element_text.description: Defaults to true. When a step uses element_text but no current accessibility text state is available, capture get_window_state(include_text:true, include_screenshot:false) from the hydrated window before resolving the unique, tool-compatible element_index.

default_window.description: Alias for window; useful when the caller wants to distinguish the batch default from a step-specific window.

final_state.description: When true, capture get_window_state once after the batch using the latest hydrated window. This is the preferred verification step for batched actions and is where final_state_expect_text should be evaluated.

final_state_expect_case_sensitive.description: Defaults to false. Set true when final_state_expect_text matching should be case-sensitive.

final_state_expect_mode.description: Defaults to all. Use any when any one of several expected final-state text candidates is sufficient.

final_state_expect_text.description: Optional substring or substrings expected in the raw final text state. Requires final_state:true and final_state_include_text:true. Missing text marks the batch failed while still returning the fresh state.

final_state_include_screenshot.description: Defaults to false. Set true when the final state should include screenshots.

final_state_include_text.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when final_state_include_screenshot is true.

final_state_max_tree_depth.description: Optional UIA tree depth budget forwarded to final get_window_state.

final_state_max_tree_nodes.description: Optional UIA tree node budget forwarded to final get_window_state.

final_state_poll_attempts.description: Defaults to 1. When final_state_expect_text is set, capture final_state up to this many times until the expected text is observed after async UI repaint.

final_state_poll_sleep_ms.description: Defaults to 1000. Delay between final_state polling attempts after the first capture.

final_state_sleep_ms.description: Optional delay immediately before final_state capture, useful for waiting for UI repaint/settle before verifying once.

lightweight_retry_sleep_ms.description: Defaults to 2000. Delay before retrying a timed-out lightweight discovery or rehydration call inside run_steps.

post_step_sleep_ms.description: Defaults to 100. Default delay after each successful step unless the step has post_action_sleep_ms.

recover_state_capture.description: Defaults to true. When a get_window_state step or final_state capture fails with target_minimized, capture_failed, or timeout and refetch:true, run_steps activates the current window, refreshes it with get_window, and retries that state capture once.

rehydrate_on_target_stale.description: Defaults to true. When a window-targeting step fails with target_stale/refetch, run_steps refreshes the current window with get_window and retries that same step once. Element and screenshot stale errors are not retried automatically.

retry_lightweight_timeouts.description: Defaults to true. When list_apps, list_windows, or get_window times out inside run_steps, wait lightweight_retry_sleep_ms and retry that same lightweight call once. Input actions are never retried by this option.

return_step_results.description: Defaults to true. When false, return only the batch summary and final hydrated state.

state.description: Optional prior get_window_state result. run_steps can hydrate window, screenshotId, and accessibilityRevision from it.

state_max_tree_lines.description: Optional maximum number of accessibility tree lines returned in the final state. With state_tree_filter, this caps candidate lines; without it, this returns a bounded front excerpt.

state_tree_context_lines.description: Optional number of neighboring tree lines to keep around each state_tree_filter match.

state_tree_filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter, or array of alternative filters, applied to state-like accessibility.tree values returned by run_steps, including step results and final state. Multiple filters match when any candidate appears, keeping large trees concise for the model.

state_tree_front_matter_lines.description: Defaults to 1 when state_tree_filter is provided. Keeps leading accessibility.tree lines before filtered candidates for orientation. Set 0 to return only candidates and context.

state_tree_include_critical_context.description: Defaults to true. When run_steps compacts an accessibility tree, include focused_element, selected_text, selected_elements, and document_text in accessibility.treeFilter.criticalContext when present.

state_tree_no_match_fallback.description: Defaults to true. When state_tree_filter finds no candidates, return a bounded front excerpt instead of an empty tree.

steps.description: Ordered tool calls. First provide or resolve a window/state, then do stable actions such as activate_window, click, type_text, press_key, or set_value. Use short post-action waits only when UI repaint is expected. Prefer final_state:true to verify once at the end instead of refetching between every step.

arguments.description: Arguments for this step's tool. If omitted, an empty object is used. run_steps can fill missing window, screenshotId, and accessibilityRevision from the current state, prior get_window/launch_app output, or a fresh state returned by an earlier step. For click, set_value, and perform_secondary_action, element_text can be used instead of element_index after a current get_window_state(include_text:true); it must match exactly one accessibility node or tree line.

post_action_sleep_ms.description: Optional delay after this step for UI settling. Keep this short and prefer final_state for verification.

repeat.description: Defaults to 1. Repeat this same tool call a bounded number of times for stable actions. element_index/element_text cannot repeat. Coordinate repeat additionally requires post_action_state:true and post_action_include_screenshot:true so each repetition receives a fresh screenshotId.

tool.description: Tool name for this step, for example get_window, get_window_state, activate_window, click, type_text, press_key, drag, scroll, set_value, or perform_secondary_action.

stop_on_error.description: Defaults to true. When true, stop at the first failed step and return failedStep plus any prior step results. When false, a failed mutating step still invalidates the latest hydrated state before later steps continue.

target.description: Optional target resolver used before steps when no window/state is provided. It uses list_apps/list_windows, chooses exactly one returned window, refreshes it with get_window, and optionally activates it before the first state capture or action.

activate.description: Defaults to auto. auto activates the resolved or already provided window before the first state capture or action only when the batch contains input or another change. true always activates; false never activates.

app_filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against list_apps id/displayName, or window.app when source is list_windows.

launch_app.description: Optional explicit app id or .exe path to launch when launch_if_missing is true and the target window is not currently returned. Use this for local builds or apps not yet discoverable in list_apps, then poll source for a matching window.

launch_if_missing.description: Defaults to false. When true and source is list_apps, if app_filter uniquely identifies an installed app but no matching window is returned, call launch_app with that app id and poll list_apps for a target window before running steps.

launch_poll_attempts.description: Defaults to 10. Number of list_apps polling attempts after launch_if_missing starts an app.

launch_poll_sleep_ms.description: Defaults to 1000. Delay between list_apps polls after launch_if_missing starts an app.

source.description: Defaults to list_apps. Use list_windows only when the task is explicitly about open windows.

window_title_filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against returned window titles.

window.description: Optional default window object containing app and id. Later steps that require a window can omit arguments.window when this is provided or when a prior state contains window.
